artifacts.notes: The Catholic Encyclopedia's index of articles beginning with 'G'. Retained because a chronology gap row rests on what this page does NOT list: the encyclopedia carries no article on the biblical book in question, and only the index can establish that. Remote bytes are not retained.
artifacts.rights_basis: The encyclopedia is public domain in the United States by publication date, but New Advent's exact transcription, markup, and presentation carry a site copyright notice and are not assumed redistributable.

edition.notes: A current New Advent delivery of the index, not a facsimile of a printed volume. The index is what settles whether the encyclopedia carries an article on a given subject at all, which is the question a gap row asks of it.
edition.title: The Catholic Encyclopedia alphabetical index, New Advent web delivery

work.author: Charles G. Herbermann and others
work.description: The alphabetical index to the original Catholic Encyclopedia (New York: Robert Appleton Company, 1907-1912), as New Advent delivers it: one page per initial letter, listing every article the encyclopedia carries under that letter. Registered as a work of its own because the index belongs to no numbered volume, and because a chronology gap row's evidence can be the ABSENCE of an entry from it.
work.title: The Catholic Encyclopedia, alphabetical index
